summary: A parent changes employment when the new job can provide their child with medical coverage.
realLife: Snyder said she took a full-time job when her son started kindergarten so that he could have medical benefits.
gates: The parent has named dependent coverage as a reason for taking the job.
inGame: needs: the dependent coverage attached to the offered job.

turns.what: The parent keeps the earlier work arrangement.
turns.pulledBy: The child gains coverage through another route before the decision.

turns.what: The parent accepts a delayed start.
turns.pulledBy: The employer sets a future start date.
turns.writesBack: The family must cover the interval.
